ios.desc:
Something in your home breaks. Point your phone at it. FinderlyFix tells you what's wrong — then whether to fix it yourself or bring in a pro.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Snap it. Take a photo or a short video of the problem — the drip under the sink, the breaker that keeps tripping, the crack in the tile.
2. Get a diagnosis. FinderlyFix reads the image and explains what it's looking at, in plain language.
3. Fix it or hand it off. Follow step-by-step DIY guidance, or connect with a local pro.

WHAT ONE PHOTO GETS YOU

Diagnosis — what's wrong, how severe it is, and the suggested next step.
DIY Option — time required, skill level, an estimated cost, and the materials you'll need.
Service Option — what to expect if you'd rather not do this one yourself.
DIY Steps — the actual repair, one step at a time, with each step checked off as you go.
Additional Resources — related how-to videos worth watching first.

MORE THAN PHOTOS

Record the sound something is making — a grinding fan, a knocking pipe — and start a fix from that instead.
Ask follow-up questions in chat, and attach more photos, video or sound as you go.
Talk it through live. Start a voice conversation and show the AI the problem through your camera while you describe it. Transcripts are saved to the project.
Videos are analyzed in 30-second clips — for a longer video, you pick the 30 seconds that matter.

WHEN IT'S NOT A DIY JOB

Tell us your ZIP code and FinderlyFix connects you with local service professionals through our partner network. You choose when to submit — nothing is sent until you do. Pro matching is available in the United States only.

YOUR PROJECTS, KEPT

Every fix becomes a project you can come back to. Start as a guest without an account. Sign in later and the work you already did comes with you. Sign in with Apple, Google, or an emailed code — no password required.

PLEASE READ

FinderlyFix gives you AI-generated guidance, not professional advice. It can be wrong. Consult a qualified professional before work involving electrical systems, gas, plumbing or anything structural. In an emergency — gas smell, electrical fire, structural danger — call emergency services first. If the app tells you something unsafe or wrong, report it from the message and a person will review it.

FREE

FinderlyFix is free to use. No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

Privacy Policy: https://app.finderlyfix.com/PrivacyPolicy
Terms of Service: https://app.finderlyfix.com/TermsOfService

show_hn.title: Show HN: DIY AI that estimates home improvement costs from a video and more

quotes.text:
You take a photo or video of home project, our AI estimates the cost in seconds and it offers a DIY guide + contractors for hire. This saves time compared to scheduling contractors just to get a ballpark quote.

We’re in pre-launch on Product Hunt here:  https://www.producthunt.com/products/finderly-android-app

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/finderly/id6670176210

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=store.finderly

We’d love to hear your thoughts on accuracy, other use cases, or features that would make this more useful.

Background: This is based on our AI-powered price estimation method for home improvement services (patent pending).
